softness.doc: Feather width of the edge, as a fraction of the canvas short side; 0 = hard edge

doc: A single edge sweeps across the canvas, and neither frame moves. Let u be the coordinate along the direction (u = x when direction = right, u = W−1−x when left, u = y when down, u = H−1−y when up), and span the axis length. The edge position is e = progress × (span + S + 1), where S is the feather width in pixels; coverage cov = clamp((e − u) / S, 0, 1) (S = 0 gives cov = [u < e]). The +1 is not arbitrary: without it, at progress = 1 the u of the last column would equal e exactly, and a hard edge would leave one column of from unrendered. cov = 0 / 1 take the original bytes of from / to directly, and intermediate values are composited with the integer blend from transition.crossfade, so progress = 0 / 1 is byte-identical to from / to.
